Where the numbers come from Jupiter · the Solana chain · vicinity.city · every 30 s

Every coin here is a city's one official coin, launched by its City Founder and recorded by Vicinity on the Vicinity launchpad (a Meteora bonding curve). A coin that has launched shows its live price; the others are designed and waiting.

Every number says where it comes from: prices, market caps and 24 h volumes from Jupiter (Powered by Jupiter), each bonding curve read from the Solana chain, holders counted by vicinity.city. They refresh every 30 seconds. You trade in your own wallet on Raydium or Jupiter; Vicinity never touches your funds.

Founding Supporter snapshot Counted fairly, checked by anyone

Every wallet counts as the lower of its balance at the cutoff and its average over the 14 days before, so renting tokens for a day doesn't help. Pools and team wallets are excluded. The result is published with a Merkle root and 48 hours to challenge it. The rules.

Checking…

Once the snapshot is published, paste any wallet to see its amount and Merkle proof.
